reader_projection_acceptance.optionality: ArchiveBox, Karakeep and Linkwarden remain independent optional reader/archive sidecars or URL projections. The reader Compose overlay has no mandatory default L2 profile, and every profile is separately selectable.
reader_projection_acceptance.secret_scope: The reader launcher requires only the secret file needed by the selected profile: ArchiveBox requires none, Karakeep requires only karakeep.env, Linkwarden requires only linkwarden.env, and the combined readers profile requires both. Required secret validation runs before any Docker network side effect.
reader_projection_acceptance.canonical_boundary: Readers are disposable projections, never Canonical Store authority. The existing focused projection coverage proves Karakeep same-hash idempotency, reader binding deletion/rebuild, failure degradation without capture rollback, Linkwarden probe/export behavior, and ArchiveBox queue idempotency.
reader_projection_acceptance.degraded_behavior: A reader or archiver failure remains isolated from the core archive. The UI/API contract distinguishes configured, connected and degraded state rather than claiming a projection has succeeded.

l2_archive_acceptance.archivebox: An empty ArchiveBox queue is a no-op. A populated queue may be submitted only after the owner explicitly sets SOCIAL_ARCHIVE_L2_ENABLED to an accepted true value; without it the script exits before invoking Docker. The focused fake-Docker test proves both the zero-side-effect disabled path and the explicit enabled invocation path.
l2_archive_acceptance.archiveweb_page: The local WACZ importer blocks before reading input, creating a runtime database, or copying to CAS while L2 is disabled. With L2 enabled it rejects an unknown canonical content_id before importing, and accepts a valid existing canonical content only as an L2 WACZ artifact while preserving the canonical content fields.
l2_archive_acceptance.l2_default: High-fidelity HTML, screenshot, PDF, WARC and WACZ paths are L2 only. L0/L1/L3 remain the normal free capture path; the task does not turn on high-fidelity archival by default.
